premises: A feedback gain cannot be optimized from a rollout in which the associated error is identically zero.
A gain is decision-relevant if it changes a future closed-loop result used by cost or constraints.
derivation_steps: Nominal dynamics: xbar_next=f_probe(xbar,tau_ff;eta_hat), so tau_ff controls the mean contact trajectory.
For horizon at least two and nonzero P or injected uncertainty, dP_next/dk=(dA_cl/dk)P A_cl^T+A_cl P(dA_cl/dk)^T is generally nonzero even when nominal error is zero.
first_principles.derived_intervention: Joint nominal mean and gain-conditioned deviation prediction.

assumptions: Disturbance or model uncertainty is nonzero in the admitted scan envelope.
boundaries: If uncertainty and deviations are negligible, fixed impedance is sufficient and the variable-impedance claim is unnecessary.

premises: Independent damping is not necessary if local closed-loop poles uniquely determine it from stiffness and contact state.
derivation_steps: Compute contact-frame effective mass and local environment slopes.
Reject stiffness whose derived damping violates bounds.
first_principles.derived_intervention: Two-decision normal-tangential stiffness with state-derived damping.
first_principles.rmc_resolution_rationale: It is the smallest impedance parameterization with explicit local dynamic meaning.
assumptions: The contact-frame dominant modes are locally second order over one horizon.
boundaries: Promote damping to an independent decision only if matched constrained tests change action or outcome.

search_space_closures.closure_rationale: T-RO plus AuSoScan supplies the minimal probe-contact replacement; more contact mechanisms are conditional test branches, not new routes.
Predictive impedance, robust MPC and energy evidence close the formula interface; the remaining issue is a principle test, not a literature gap.

principle_search_record.closure_rationale: The existing field map and supplied full texts identify sufficient mechanisms for both RMCs. R15 stops search after one T-RO-centered principle, rejects NNBO by explicit control-authority derivation, and leaves only empirical action-fidelity and WCET tests.

solution_space_constraint_assessment.constraint_basis: Under the same ultrasound task, gain-only A2-I and nominal-only A2-II have zero gain authority at zero tracking error. Probe-contact NNBO retains an optimal force relation, but force-to-impedance realization is nonunique and singular at zero error; direct four-gain HJB loses authority in the same condition and becomes a state-constrained minimizer, while two-stiffness state-derived damping is nonaffine. Meeting wrench, slip, energy, actuator, rate and deadline limits therefore requires the same constrained predictive relation already present in the T-RO backbone. This causal and feasibility constraint, rather than the solver identity or user preference, leaves one scientific intervention.

candidate_principles.principle: Jointly rank nominal action and minimal normal-tangential impedance through future contact-conditioned mean and closed-loop deviation outcomes, and apply task, contact, actuator, gain-energy and deadline authority to that same published action.
candidate_principles.origin_chain_rationale: The chain begins with the complete T-RO method, replaces only invalid probe geometry, then repairs predefined/nominally redundant impedance by predicting its closed-loop outcome.
activation_conditions: Continuous soft-contact ultrasound scanning with nonzero disturbance or parameter uncertainty
Future normal-tangential contact changes closed-loop risk or a hard margin
A high-level verified solution and low-level impedance loop can meet the registered deadline
candidate_principles.intervention: Use cylinder-probe contact in T-RO; retain torque as the nominal action; optimize two contact-frame stiffness variables through a gain-conditioned deviation covariance rollout; derive damping from local effective mass and environment slopes; project the same sequence through contact, actuator, rate and tank constraints; publish verified SCAN or WITHDRAW.
candidate_principles.changed_structure: T-RO's contact prediction formerly selected only feedforward torque while feedback impedance was predefined. R15 adds the feedback-controlled deviation state to the same prediction, so future contact determines both mean torque and closed-loop compliance without a second controller.
candidate_principles.root_cause_resolution_rationale: Probe contact distinctions affect the selected gain only through explicit A_cl, covariance or hard-margin paths. Torque and gains have independent authority, and the optimized member is also the energy-, constraint- and deadline-authorized applied member.
failure_conditions: Cylinder-probe and reduced deviation state do not preserve held-out gain action order
Independent damping or richer SPD impedance repeatedly changes feasibility or joint outcome
Full-envelope robust constraints or the withdrawal member are not containing
Fixed-budget DDP/IK/Projection ADMM cannot meet target WCET
A learned residual is persistently action-changing and cannot be contained by the physical envelope

fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: Escalate only the falsified contact term; persistent noncontainment kills the physical formulation.

fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: Loss of action-order or hard-decision fidelity kills the reduced real-time method.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: Two stiffness variables with state-derived damping are decision sufficient.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: Promote damping or richer impedance only if a matched constrained rival dominates.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: The tank conservatively accounts for positive energy injected by gain changes.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: Freeze or decrease gains; the time-varying feedback-passivity claim fails.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: A verified incumbent or preverified withdrawal can be published by every deadline.

target_domain_operationalization: State z contains nominal robot/probe contact, reduced covariance and tank energy; auxiliary estimator state contains bounded contact parameters and covariance.
Action is [tau_ff,k_n,k_t]; d_n,d_t are derived from local effective mass, contact slopes and chosen damping ratio.
DDP updates nominal dynamics and small gain block, IK preserves scan path, Projection enforces tightened contact/slip/torque/joint/rate/damping/tank constraints, and ADMM maintains consensus.
The low-level law executes feedforward torque plus contact-frame impedance about the nominal trajectory.
At timeout, infeasibility or envelope exit, stop tangential advance and unload with a preverified dissipative rate-limited impedance.

target_intervention_novelty.uncovered_residual_delta: T-RO predicts deformable contact but leaves impedance predefined; existing online impedance planning does not supply the same probe-specific contact and DDP/IK/Projection backbone. R15's residual is the explicit mean/deviation authority split that turns future probe contact into online normal-tangential impedance in that backbone.
target_intervention_novelty.mechanism_delta: Add gain-conditioned closed-loop deviation dynamics at the exact predefined-impedance interface of T-RO.
target_intervention_novelty.scientific_delta: Test whether future probe contact prediction can jointly select nominal force/motion and minimum sufficient feedback compliance under hard energy and deadline authority.

candidate_principles.provisional_scientific_delta: Future deformable-contact prediction becomes a closed-loop compliance decision, not only a torque trajectory: one T-RO ADMM problem jointly chooses nominal torque and minimal normal-tangential impedance through separate mean and deviation outcome channels.
candidate_principles.substantive_difference: Relative to T-RO, impedance is online and future-contact-conditioned. Relative to MPVIC, the plant is probe-specific deformable normal-tangential contact and the gains enter T-RO's DDP/IK/Projection relation. Relative to NNBO, impedance is the constrained action rather than an underdetermined realization of optimal wrench.

predictions.observable: gain action order, force variance, slip/contact-loss margin and joint force/path outcome
predictions.pattern_a: CMI-MPC changes gains and improves or preserves robust joint outcome under disturbance while naive nominal A2-II cannot rank gains
predictions.pattern_b: A conservatively tuned fixed impedance is action- and outcome-equivalent across the admitted envelope, making online deviation-conditioned gain choice unnecessary
predictions.activation_condition: Matched scans with nonzero disturbance or contact uncertainty
predictions.killer_criterion: Kill the deviation augmentation if it does not change decisions or outcomes.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Recorded-transition replay before new hardware trials.

predictions.observable: held-out force/contact containment, active constraints and gain order
predictions.pattern_a: Cylinder baseline contains outcomes and preserves decisions
predictions.pattern_b: Dynamic asymmetry or deformation resistance changes a repeated optimal gain or hard decision
predictions.killer_criterion: Add only the specific falsified contact term; kill the baseline on persistent action-changing noncontainment.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Nested model replay on identical histories.

predictions.observable: gain difference and joint outcome after equalizing objectives, tuning budget, horizon and inner-loop bandwidth
predictions.pattern_a: Future-contact-conditioned gain selection retains a decision and outcome benefit after all tuning factors are matched
predictions.pattern_b: The apparent benefit disappears after objective, horizon, tuning or bandwidth matching
predictions.activation_condition: Matched contact histories, constraints, sensing and compute budget
predictions.killer_criterion: Reject the claimed mechanism benefit if tuning/objective mismatch explains the action and outcome difference.

predictions.observable: offline feasible action, 99.9-percentile online latency and verified publication
predictions.pattern_a: The joint relation publishes verified SCAN or WITHDRAW at every deadline and preserves the offline mechanism decision
predictions.pattern_b: The offline joint relation is feasible and outcome-equivalent but the online implementation alone fails from latency
predictions.activation_condition: Forced timeouts and infeasibility on target hardware
predictions.killer_criterion: Attribute failure to compute implementation rather than the scientific relation when only the latency-matched implementation fails.

predictions.observable: pre-guard gain, realized gain, feedback-port energy and joint outcome
predictions.pattern_a: Internal gain-energy authority changes a candidate gain exactly when unaccounted positive stiffness work would exceed the tank
predictions.pattern_b: A standard post-hoc guard produces exactly the same realized gain, energy and outcome on every activated case
predictions.activation_condition: Rate-limited stiffness increases at nonzero contact-frame deviation
predictions.killer_criterion: Demote internal tank authority if the post-hoc guard is exactly action- and outcome-equivalent without deadline or feasibility loss.
predictions.cheapest_informative_rationale: Logged replay of identical proposed gain schedules and contact deviations.

candidate_principles.status_rationale: R15 is the single complete T-RO-centered principle after explicit rejection of gain-only A2-I, naive nominal A2-II, and both NNBO gain-realization branches. Remaining uncertainties are registered principle tests, not alternative routes.
